english.title: Re use protected animal after regulated procedure
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a protected animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), that had been subjected to one or more regulated procedures specified in section 2 of the Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986, for a further regulated procedure, namely **(..SPECIFY REGULATED PROCEDURE..), when

(A)_[the Secretary of State had not consented to such further use]_
(B)_[a condition specified in section 14 of the said Act, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), had not been met]_
(C)_[the Secretary of State had not consented to such further use and a condition specified in Section 14 of the said Act, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONDITION..), had not been met]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 14 and 22(3)(a) of the Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
used a protected animal
that had been subjected to one or more regulated procedures
for further regulated procedures
when the Secretary of State had not consented to such further use and/or a condition specified in section 14 of the Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986 had not been met

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Imprisonment for this offence will be abolished when section 332 and Sch 37 Pt 9 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force.
(ii) The current section 14 was substituted by S.I. 2012/3039

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions;
Within three years after the commission of the offence and within six months after the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the Director of Public Prosecutions to justify the proceedings comes to his knowledge.
